entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: %s must be lowered by lowerCountValues, not the generic aggregate path
entries.rationale: count_values is intercepted by lowerCountValues / lowerSubqueryOverCountValues on every parser-producible path before buildAggFunc is consulted. lowerPlainAggOverMixedFloatArm (cerberus issue #2346, histogram_native_mixed_or_aggregate.go) is the second caller, and only ever passes an agg whose Op sumOrAvgOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp already confirmed is SUM or AVG (expHistogramAggOpIsMergeable), never COUNT_VALUES, so it cannot reach this branch either

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: aggregation %s does not take a parameter
entries.rationale: the parser rejects a parameter on non-parameterised aggregations ("wrong number of arguments for aggregate expression"). lowerPlainAggOverMixedFloatArm (cerberus issue #2346, histogram_native_mixed_or_aggregate.go) is the second caller, and only ever passes an agg whose Param sumOrAvgOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp already confirmed is nil, so it cannot reach this branch either

guard: case parser.SUM, parser.COUNT, parser.AVG, parser.MIN, parser.MAX, parser.STDDEV, parser.STDVAR of switch a.Op

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: group() does not take a parameter
entries.rationale: the parser rejects a parameter on group() ("wrong number of arguments for aggregate expression"). lowerPlainAggOverMixedFloatArm (cerberus issue #2346, histogram_native_mixed_or_aggregate.go) is the second caller, and only ever passes an agg whose Op sumOrAvgOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp already confirmed is SUM or AVG (expHistogramAggOpIsMergeable), never GROUP, so it cannot reach this branch either

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: aggregation op %s is not yet supported
entries.rationale: defensive fallback: every PromQL aggregator the parser emits (sum/avg/count/min/max/group/stddev/stdvar/topk/bottomk/count_values/quantile/limitk/limit_ratio) is dispatched by lowerAggregate or handled in buildAggFunc's switch, so no wire-reachable query reaches this branch. It guards against a future parser op landing unlowered. lowerPlainAggOverMixedFloatArm (cerberus issue #2346, histogram_native_mixed_or_aggregate.go) is the second caller, and only ever passes an agg whose Op sumOrAvgOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp already confirmed is SUM or AVG — both handled by the switch's first case — so it cannot reach this default arm either

guard: past exhaustive switch a.Op over [case parser.SUM, parser.COUNT, parser.AVG, parser.MIN, parser.MAX, parser.STDDEV, parser.STDVAR; case parser.GROUP; case parser.QUANTILE; case parser.COUNT_VALUES]
